description: This Swift source file implements classes and functions related to voice push-to-talk functionality on macOS. It includes monitoring hotkeys for the right Option key to start and end voice capture, as well as managing speech recognition sessions, audio input, and overlay UI updates during speech capture.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalkHotkey
classes.description: Manages global and local monitoring of the right Option key to trigger push-to-talk voice recognition sessions.

classes.name: VoicePushToTalk
classes.description: Handles the core logic for initiating, managing, and finalizing voice recognition sessions for push-to-talk functionality, including speech recognition setup and overlay management.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables hotkey monitoring for push-to-talk.

methods.name: startMonitoring
methods.description: Starts observing key events for hotkey detection.

methods.name: handleFlagsChanged
methods.description: Handles event when modifier flags change, primarily to detect the right Option key state.

methods.name: withMainThread
methods.description: Executes a block on the main thread.

methods.name: updateModifierState
methods.description: Updates internal state based on key code and modifier flags, starting or stopping voice capture accordingly.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Starts a new voice recognition session, requesting permissions and setting up recognition.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the active voice recognition session and finalizes the captured speech.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition process with configured locale.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes recognition results, updating UI overlays with transcriptions.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Completes and publishes the final recognized speech, with optional timeout fallback.

methods.name: makeConfig
methods.description: Builds the configuration for the current session, including mic ID, locale, and chimes.
